resources.string: %1$d samples retained · last 60 s · at most 120 samples
Collected only while Connection details is open and the controller is visible. Closing pauses collection; reopening keeps unexpired samples. Gaps are not measured.
Skipped increases: %1$s\nUnderrun increases: %2$s\nThese are observed increases, not session totals. Only adjacent samples no more than 1 s apart count.

Trends run from older to newer; each uses its own scale. Dots are measured samples, never estimates across gaps. Rendered FPS uses a one-second window; each client p95 sample uses the recent frame window. Client latency is receipt to render, not network or glass-to-glass latency. Audio queue is the client PCM queue. History stays in memory only: no persistence or upload, no addresses or clipboard contents stored.
Requested encoder rate, not measured bandwidth.
